title: OpenAPI Components Generate Executor
description: Inferred on a project tagged generate:openapi-components. Render the DTO library's components-only components.openapi.json (every exported type it declares, info.version = package version) with the consumer's own @webpieces/openapi-generator, into the outputPath of the ONE target this target dependsOn (the library's build).

manifest.description: Workspace-relative path to the library's "kind": "components" openapi.manifest.json. No default.

format.description: Which serializations to write. components.openapi.json is what contract documents $ref, so JSON is always written. No default.
